intro.text: A well-known darkeyed wrestler in Kholinar.

items.text: In 1151 Makh's opponent for a featured bout in a firemoss den dropped out sick. While Makh argued with the organisers, Dalinar challenged him, but Makh refused for fear of being maimed. Bashin and Havar told Dalinar he had recently maimed several men in a tavern fight, which he didn't remember.

appearance.text: Tall and powerfully built, with enormous arms, a bald head and dark green eyes.

personality.text: Angry and aggressive, but not foolhardy.
